name: Bitcoin / US dollar
notes: Trades every day, so 'daily gaps' are weekend-free; exchange outages and extreme moves are possible; assumed retail fees (0.1 %). Broker terms unverified. gap_stress_pct = 1.25 x the worst overnight gap 14.1% in the cleaned usable history (floor per asset class, capped at 25 % because unadjusted contract rolls inflate the historical maximum); min_stop_pct = 25 % of the median daily range 3.33%.
